steps.decisions: A worker replica count is not throughput evidence. Historical 660 ms status reads do not prove the new boundary meets its target. Manual scaling is not autoscaling. An interrupted worker test does not prove host or zone failover.

readme: Source-priority guidance. Several links name files that are absent at those paths. Use the real original paths listed here.
main: One FastAPI application registers auth, upload, jobs, HLS and operator routes.
auth: Cookie token and shared users-table lookup. No bearer-token support here.
upload: Video type checks, 100 MiB limit, source storage, job creation, then enqueue.
job: jobs.owner_id references users.id. No separate Asset aggregate or recorded attempts in this model.
repository: Owner filtering, conditional state changes, retry preparation and stale-job queries.
jobs: Status, listing, stored-source retry, edits, deletion and operator routes.
hls: Owner-checked playlist bodies and signed segment redirects.
worker: Worker claims and state updates use the shared job repository.
reaper: Fails stale processing rows, re-enqueues some missing RQ jobs and removes old orphan source objects.
config: Defaults: 60-second recovery interval, 1,800-second processing lease, 3,600-second orphan/queued grace.
compose: API, workers and reaper share credentials and PostgreSQL DSN. Worker replica count can change. No CPU caps are specified.
frontend: Authentication, upload, polling, playback, library and editing controls. Retry at lines 410–412 uploads lastFile again.
ci: Lint, Python/frontend/integration tests, image build, Sonar and Trivy. Sonar is optional/report-only. Trivy gates fixable HIGH/CRITICAL findings.
dast: Authenticated ZAP scan. Findings are report-only. A scan execution error fails the job.
storage: Current workers use MinIO credentials to read sources and write outputs.
ladder: Best-effort renditions at up to 360p, 480p and 720p, constrained by source height.
authroute: Registration, login, logout and current user. Secure HttpOnly cookie. Logout removes the cookie, not the token’s validity.
auth_tests: Tests exist for anonymous access, owner filtering and operator restrictions. Not executed during this planning review.
retry_tests: Tests exist for stored-source retry and queue/commit failure handling. Not executed during this planning review.
recovery_tests: Tests cover stale processing, missing RQ jobs and orphan objects. No new timing result is established.
decisions: User-supplied approval, open DDD action, selected local baseline and future repository transition. Recorded 9 October 2026. Original feedback date unknown.
